card.name: Scattered words in technical news text
card.fires_on: No single word type or setting; it fires on assorted words such as buffer, call, vehicles, cycle and burn in general technical or news prose.
card.writes: Suppresses time-of-day and season words (Chinese and English), but the promoted tokens are unrelated, so the effect is weak.
card.plain: It responds to a mix of unrelated words in web text, and nothing in common was found across the passages.
